notes.title: Quick Update and Thank You!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It’s been a hectic week, but I just wanted to thank you all for your support and for taking the time to play the game that I’ve created. It means the world to me, and I’m going to try my best to get the rest of the chapters out to you as soon as I can!

[u][b]Minor update[/b][/u]
I noticed that if you use the Chapter jump from the main menu, it didn’t ask for your name and used the default name instead. My apologies if this affected you, I’ve now added this to the list of questions.
If you’re affected by this, or you just want to change your name, you can now go to the temp shop app on the second page of your in-game phone and type in the code: [b]changemyname[/b]. In the future, I’ll have an additional way to change your name as well.

[u][b]Germany Players[/b][/u]
If you live in Germany, I’m sure you already know that you cannot purchase the DLC. I’m genuinely sorry, I wish there were some way for you to play it on Steam, but right now, until there are some changes on Steam, I’m not sure when that will be. 

Although not ideal, there are other platforms to receive the game. The closest to the release format on Steam would be on itch.io, but that is about a month away from release. There’s also Patreon and Subscribestar, but they do follow a very different release format. In the future, the plan is for Time For You to be available to purchase on zero2herogames.com as well. 

[u][b]Chapter 03[/b][/u]
Next month I’ll be showing off some of the new locations you’ll be visiting in Chapter 03, along with some of the characters you’ll see.


Also, if you have some time, consider leaving a review. I would really appreciate it! As a new indie developer, any traction helps :)


More news soon, and thanks for the support!

If you haven’t already, follow Zero2HeroGames on [url=https://twitter.com/Zero2Games]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/zero2herogames/]Instagram[/url] for Time For You news and future contests to win some Steam keys! If you’re interested in Time For You BETA releases, Dev updates, monthly lewd wallpapers, and other bonuses, you can get that all at my [url=https://www.patreon.com/zero2herogames]Patreon[/url] or [url=https://subscribestar.adult/zero2herogames]Subscribestar[/url].

Cheers,

ZeroHero
